name.title: Hospital name
name.description: Full or partial hospital name to search for, e.g. "Mayo Clinic" or "Presbyterian". Leave blank to browse by state instead.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter US state code to limit to hospitals located there, e.g. "CA".

minRating.title: Minimum star rating
minRating.description: Only return hospitals with at least this CMS overall rating (1-5 stars). Leave blank for all rated hospitals.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of hospitals to return.
